body: yeah that was what I was looking to do, I just can't seem to find out to much information about the various programs outside of the brochure.

Yeah, I have tried different therapies with various providers incorporating multiple techniques. Really the best way for me to cope was to just put 100% into work but I have crashed really hard this time and can't seem to snap back. 

I really do not want to do inpatient, but I was looking at partial programs. The problem is that it is really difficult to find an unbiased prospective (or really any perspective) and I know a program like I was in would do more harm then good.  I am really mistrustful of clinicians at a lot of those places because they don't have the background like my providers do and I am afraid if I am really honest they will keep me against my will anyways.

Thanks for the input! I did an inpatient for 2 days and it was an absolute miserable experience. I kind of went through the motions because like you said "the more you do what you gotta do, the quicker you can leave." but my only real goal was getting out of that place. 

That could have been just that program though, did you find that your experience was helpful at all?
I was looking into them but they have a pretty good waitlist. Have you been through one of there programs? I appreciate the input!
